articles.summary: Event to be Webcast Live on the MediaAlpha Investor Relations Website LOS ANGELES, Feb. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MediaAlpha, Inc. (NYSE: MAX), today announced that it will release fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results on Monday, February 23, 2026 after market close.
